newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OPEC agrees to freeze its output ceiling.
newsitem.headline: OPEC agrees to freeze its output ceiling.

text.p: OPEC ministers meeting in Vienna have agreed to freeze their output ceiling, OPEC secretary-general Rilwanu Lukman told reporters.
The existing accord sets a ceiling on total production by the 11 members at 25.03 million barrels daily, although monitors say that quota violations have added some two million to that.
Lukman said the new OPEC freeze would last for six months from July 1 with the 11 members keeping their existing oil output quotas unchanged.
He said all members gave a pledge to return volumes produced to their mandated quota levels.
Earlier, Iran's minister, Gholamreza Aghazadeh, said OPEC had solved the issue of quota compliance. Monitors of OPEC output say Venezuela has been the biggest violator.
Lukman said that no threats had been made against those alleged to have exceeded limits.
